sentences.en: The architect boasted that he had received a prestigious award.
sentences.zh: 这位建筑师自夸说他获得了重要奖项。

sentences.en: Prizes will be awarded at the end of the contest.
sentences.zh: 比赛结束后将颁发奖品。

sentences.en: They awarded her first prize at the flower show.
sentences.zh: 在花展上，她们授予她一等奖。

senses.zh: 奖；（收入的）增加；（赔偿）裁定额；（毕业证书等的）授予；奖学金
